relations.text: ネスレにパッケージ商品の世界的な流通権を与えている
relations.text_en: Nestlé holds global rights to distribute certain Starbucks branded packaged goods

source.label: Starbucks Corporation 10-K(2025年9月28日期)
source.quote: Our Channel Development business is heavily reliant on Nestlé, which holds global rights to distribute certain Starbucks branded packaged goods.

relations.text: ネスレから製品販売とロイヤルティ収入を得ている
relations.text_en: Starbucks earns product sales and royalty revenues from Nestlé

source.label: Starbucks Corporation 10-K(2025年9月28日期)
source.quote: Most of our Channel Development revenues are from product sales to, and royalty revenues from, Nestlé through the Global Coffee Alliance.

relations.text: 北米ではペプシ・コーラ社との折半出資の合弁で瓶入り飲料を扱う
relations.text_en: In North America a joint venture with the Pepsi-Cola Company handles bottled beverages

source.label: Starbucks Corporation 10-K(2025年9月28日期)
source.quote: We also license the rights to produce and distribute Starbucks-branded products to our 50 % owned joint venture, The North American Coffee Partnership with the Pepsi-Cola Company, which develops and distributes bottled Starbucks ® beverages

companies.name: ボーユー・キャピタル

relations.text: 中国の店舗運営に向けた合弁会社を組むことで合意した
relations.text_en: Starbucks agreed to form a joint venture to operate its retail business in China

source.label: Starbucks Corporation 10-K(2025年9月28日期)
source.quote: we announced the Company has entered an agreement to form a joint venture with Boyu Capital, a leading alternative investment firm, to operate Starbucks retail in China.

companies.name: タタ・スターバックス

relations.text: インドでライセンス店舗を運営する持分法適用の関連会社である
relations.text_en: It operates licensed Starbucks stores in India and is an equity method investment

source.label: Starbucks Corporation 10-K(2025年9月28日期)
source.quote: Tata Starbucks Limited (India) operates licensed Starbucks ® retail stores.
